title: Exact admission-family performance readiness verification
scope: Verify additive factor-space reconciliation, exact A0-A7 offline measurement authority, deterministic no-timing campaign compilation, fail-closed negative cases, and the explicit stop before host-sensitive execution. This artifact does not claim measured performance, a stable rule, performance acceptance, active behavior, or production readiness.
verification_method: Canonical JSON schema and hash validation; exact catalog, proof, campaign, manifest, cell, and policy-tuple checks; focused positive and negative runtime authorization tests; deterministic compiler replay; Release builds; direct touched-artifact SpecTrace validation; and diff hygiene.
preconditions: The passed A0 through A7 correctness result and its current reviewed proof catalog remain present.
No execution host or workload scope has yet been selected for performance measurement.
Performance acceptance, adaptive selection, active behavior, and production activation remain false.

Verify exactly A0 through A7 are the reviewed exhaustive measurement subset and all bounded cells remain blocked.
Create an exact admission performance authorization for each A0-A7 tuple and reject mismatched hashes, cells, values, adjacent axes, or concurrent authorization tokens.
Compile the campaign twice and prove byte-identical canonical output without collecting timing observations.
Reject covering-array requests, blocked values, stale inputs, outside axes, correctness intent, performance-acceptance intent, and active intent.
Run focused source tests and Release builds with the repository's documented analyzer floor.
Validate SPEC-QUIC-CRT-ADMISSION-PERFORMANCE, ARC-QUIC-CRT-0119, WI-QUIC-CRT-0120, and VER-QUIC-CRT-0121 directly.
Run git diff --check and confirm no actual measurement, CI change, push, or production activation occurred.
expected_result: The current factor space is reconciled additively; only the exact reviewed A0 through A7 family can receive internal offline measurement authorization; dry-run compilation is deterministic and fail-closed; focused tests and builds pass or retain a precise inherited analyzer blocker; and actual timing remains pending the selected execution environment and workload scope.
status_summary: Readiness portion passed: 21 deterministic contract assertions, eight reviewed and four blocked factor cells, eight compiled dry-run work items, four fail-closed campaign mutations, 12 focused authorization tests, 55 combined admission and oversized-outcome tests, and the analyzer-enabled Incursa.Quic Release build all passed. The full test project completed with 10,244 passed, 4 skipped, and 5 unrelated baseline failures in Windows path budget, completion-source reflection ambiguity, a retained gate-field inventory, and sent-packet layout. The retained A0-A7 evidence validator reports admission_runtime_binary_stale after the runtime authorization change, preserving its original binary provenance. Actual measurements run: zero. Host selection, workload scope, performance-runner extension, raw evidence, and effect analysis remain pending.
